title: How to Prepare a Dashboard Project Before Hiring
h1: How to prepare a dashboard project before hiring
description: Prepare a dashboard project: decisions it supports, key measures, data sources, tools, access, refresh schedule, design and what to ask a data specialist.
intro: A dashboard turns numbers from many places into one screen that helps people make decisions. A good one answers a few important questions at a glance. A poor one is a crowded page of charts that nobody uses. Most of the difference comes from preparation. This article explains what to decide, what to gather and what to ask before you hire someone to build a dashboard in a tool such as Power BI, Tableau or a spreadsheet.

faq.q: What if my data is messy?
faq.a: Tell the specialist early. Cleaning and combining data is often the largest part of the job.
